title: AirStack registry stack entry (stacks/<name>.yaml)
description: One registered stack in the airstack-modules-index (RFC #379 §7). A stack is a self-contained folder in its home repo (modules.repos + launch/ + docker-compose.yaml + wiring.md + README — RFC #379 §3); this entry only points the catalog at it. The docs site embeds the stack's CI-generated wiring.md from the home repo. Consumed by tools/validate_entry.py.

name.description: Stack identity (lowercase snake_case) — the stack folder's basename and this entry's filename: stacks/<name>.yaml.

repo.description: HTTPS GitHub URL of the repo hosting the stack folder — castacks/AirStack for trunk reference stacks; stacks need not live in trunk (RFC #379 §3).

path.description: Repo-relative path of the stack folder, e.g. stacks/full_default.

description.description: One-line human description shown in the marketplace catalog.

airstack_compat.description: Trunk semver range the stack was tested against — copied from the airstack_compat: key in the stack's modules.repos (RFC #379 §3). Declared, not verified; the verified claim is a CI-stamped compat matrix / release-set tag.

wiring.description: Repo-relative path to the stack's CI-generated wiring.md in the home repo — the docs site embeds it on the stack's catalog page. Never hand-edited (RFC #379 §4).
